info.title: kestrel operator
info.summary: The boundary a Client reaches a control plane over.
info.description: Server-sent events down, JSON up, plain HTTP. It authenticates nobody, so the control plane serves it on a listener of its own, apart from the link, and binds that listener to loopback unless told otherwise. A remote control plane is reached through a tunnel. Every operation refuses with 403, and does nothing, a request whose Host is not loopback, or whose Origin, when it sends one, is not exactly http:// followed by that Host.

Refused.description: The control plane refused the request, with a typed Diagnostic (ADR-0052) where its producer is typed and a plain Refusal where it is not yet; only `kind` tells them apart. 400 is a malformed request; 403 is a forbidden action, such as changing a Held Message its author did not write; 404 is a missing or ambiguous reference; 409 is a state conflict, or a declined operation not yet typed; 410 is an expired resource; 422 is an invalid field value; 503 is a control plane that could not answer; 504 is an Instance that did not answer a read within 10 s. 400, 503 and 504 are always typed.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before asking again. Present on a 503 only when the database was busy, which asking again can clear; the Diagnostic's `retry_after_seconds` carries the same value.

SavedSignIn.description: Material saved for a catalogued Sign-in Method, as everything but the Session it is handed to sees it.

revision.description: Minted for every accepted write of the material, a generic Profile or Provider Credential write included, and never reused.

refreshed_from.description: The revision a harness's own refresh advanced to make this one, or null when it was saved, imported or written.

model_use.description: The latest result per model of this harness using this revision. A result for one model never stands for another.

reference.description: The Profile's name, or the Provider Credential's variable.

AuthenticationEvidence.description: Whether this revision authenticates, which says nothing of whether a harness can use a model with it. `login_completed` is a finished vendor sign-in and `credential_accepted` a provider accepting the one request recorded in `provider_check`; neither is a model call. Expiry and lack of coverage are only ever established by evidence.

ProviderCheck.description: One authenticated model-metadata read. Only `rejected` says the provider refused the credential; `inconclusive` is a refusal about permission, credit or another matter; `unavailable` includes a timeout and a rate or quota limit.

provider_error.description: The provider's error type or code, never its message.

image.description: The image a model test ran in; null for a Session, which records none.

repositories.description: The repositories the work happens against, in order: an http(s)://, ssh://, git:// or file:// URL, an scp-style `user@host:path`, a local path on the Instance beginning `/`, `./` or `../`, or `owner/repo` or `github.com/owner/repo`, which is held as its HTTPS `.git` address.

integrations.description: The Integration each connected repository reaches GitHub as. Absent or empty selects none: neither a GitHub address nor an Event ever selects one. A repository named here is held as its HTTPS address whatever transport it was given by. Before a selection, its repository or the branch is saved new or changed, the selected App is asked for the repository and the branch.

repository.description: One of the declared repositories, as given there or as it resolves.

integration.description: The name of an enabled GitHub Integration in the Organization that carries outbound and watches this repository.

SelectedIntegration.description: Selected explicitly, and never replaced by another Integration when this one is disabled or retired.

repository.description: The repository's address as the Project or Workspace holds it.

integration.description: The Integration's name as it reads now.

model.description: The model it works with. Absent or null names none, and the Harness's own default is the answer.

mode.description: The mode it works in. Absent or null names none, and the Harness's own default is the answer.

thought_level.description: The thought level it works at. Absent or null names none, and the Harness's own default is the answer.

DeclarationChange.description: What applying a Declaration does to one record. Whether a route lists a record it leaves unchanged is that route's choice.

filter.description: A CloudEvents filter of exact, prefix, suffix, all, any, or not.

every.description: A duration such as `1h`, counted from the declaration, in place of a filter.

cron.description: Five fields of minute, hour, day of the month, month and day of the week, such as `0 9 * * 1-5`, in place of a filter or an interval.

zone.description: The IANA time zone a cron expression is read in, such as `America/New_York`.

on_miss.description: What a correlation miss does: `open` or `ignore`.

on_open_workspace.description: What a firing that correlates to an open Workspace does: `continue` its waiting Session, or `new-session` with this Trigger's Agent. Absent continues.

model.description: The model its Sessions run with. Omitted, the Agent's, then the Harness's default.

mode.description: The mode its Sessions run in. Omitted, the Agent's, then the Harness's default.

thought_level.description: The thought level its Sessions run at. Omitted, the Agent's, then the Harness's default.

QueueReason.description: One reason a Session has not started, for a Client to phrase.

id.description: The Workspace's own sequence. Stable and never reused: a taken or withdrawn message keeps it.

opened_with.description: The Agent its first Session runs unless that Session names another.

integrations.description: The Integration each of its repositories selected when it opened. Redeclaring its Project changes none, and one since disabled or retired still reads here.

instance.description: The Instance its Sessions execute on, while one is kept.

held.description: Why its Instance is held for work that exists nowhere else, if it is.

held_messages.description: The messages the unfinished Session cannot take yet, in arrival order.

started_by.description: The Event a firing opened it for, or the Brief's author an operator opened it with. Null when neither names anyone.

pull_requests.description: One per repository fixed on the Workspace, in the checkout's order.

unfinished_session.description: The one Session the Workspace has not let go of, while it has one.

state.description: A trailing Session has answered its Turn while work its agent started still runs: it holds its Active-Work Slot and its Instance, refuses seal, and is waiting once that work settles and its agent falls quiet.

availability.description: Unavailable when no inbound GitHub Integration in the Organization watches the repository and none has delivered a pull request from it: kestrel cannot learn its pull requests, which says nothing about whether any exist.

known.description: The pull requests learned from the declared branch in this repository; null when unavailable.

PullRequest.description: A Workspace's current value for one pull request, learned from a verified GitHub Event.

repository.description: The head repository fixed on the Workspace.

updated_at.description: When GitHub last changed it, as the Event or a read back of the pull request said.

event.description: The Event the value was learned from.

ChangingOption.description: An option change a person asked for while a Session is live, held until the harness answers it (ADR-0041).

state.description: A trailing Session has answered its Turn while work its agent started still runs: it holds its Active-Work Slot and its Instance, refuses seal, and is waiting once that work settles and its agent falls quiet.

preparing.description: The step an unbriefed Session is preparing on: provisioning from claim until its supervisor connects, cloning until its checkout is reported, starting_harness until the harness is up, and harness_ready once it is. Null in every other state.

model.description: What the Session names for its Harness's model, or null for its Harness's default.

mode.description: What the Session names for its Harness's mode, or null for its Harness's default.

thought_level.description: What the Session names for its Harness's thought level, or null for its Harness's default.

worked_model.description: The Model-category option's current value, kept current by the supervisor (ADR-0041).

sign_in_method.description: The catalogued Sign-in Method selected for this Session, or null when none was.

supplied.description: What the harness was last spawned with, by revision and never by value; empty until its supervisor takes its credentials.

title.description: The harness's own name for the conversation, or null until it says one.

changing_options.description: Option changes a person asked for while the Session is live, held until the harness answers each (ADR-0041).

commands.description: The commands the harness offers for this Session.

interrupting.description: Who asked the working Turn to stop, while the request is in flight.

usage.description: What the Harness has spent on the Session: the live figure while its agent works, otherwise the latest its Turn answer or the end of its trailing work reported.

diagnostic.description: Why the Session failed, from the evidence its supervisor established. Null when it has not failed, or failed with no evidence; its presence never makes the read fail (ADR-0052).

tools.description: Tool calls open in the current observation; empty whenever observation is unavailable.

units.description: Adapter units open in the current observation, such as a Claude background task or subagent; they keep a trailing Session trailing. Empty whenever observation is unavailable.

last_activity_at.description: When the trailing Session's agent last showed activity; null in every other state.

depends_on.description: The Sessions this one was declared to wait on, whether or not they have ended.

SessionObservation.description: Whether the Session's open work is currently observed. current: its supervisor sent a snapshot over its open link and is still reaching it; tools and units list that snapshot, empty when nothing is open. unavailable: nothing current is known, whatever the Session's state or lease; tools and units are empty and never mean nothing is open. Neither availability changes the Session's state or scheduling.

observed_at.description: When the control plane took the snapshot.

last.description: The last snapshot this control plane took for the Session, kept until the Session ends; null when it holds none, as after a restart.

LastObservation.description: A historical snapshot of the Session's open work: what was open at observed_at, not proof that it still runs or that the supervisor is reachable.

SuppliedMaterial.description: One variable or file handed to a Session's harness. It keeps the revision handed over after that material is replaced or forgotten.

reference.description: The Profile's name, or the Provider Credential's variable.

name.description: The variable, or the file's path beneath the agent's home.

method.description: The catalogued Sign-in Method of the Session's harness this fills, or null for anything else a Profile or Organization holds.

current.description: Whether that revision is still what is held.

SessionOption.description: A harness config option, whole: what it is, what it may be and what it is now.

category.description: `mode`, `model`, `model_config`, `thought_level`, or the harness's own string, which may begin with `_`.

values.description: The offered values of an ungrouped select; empty for a grouped one and for a boolean.

groups.description: The offered values of a grouped select; empty for an ungrouped one.

warns_cache.description: Whether changing this option makes the next Turn re-read the context without the prompt cache. True for a Model, ThoughtLevel or ModelConfig option, except a category kestrel's per-harness table keeps the cache for; at 0.3 that is Claude's ThoughtLevel (ADR-0041).

SessionOptionCurrent.description: The current value: a value id for a select, a boolean for a toggle.

SessionCommand.description: A command the harness offers for the Session, as a composer lists it.

Interrupting.description: A person's request that a Session's working Turn stop.

because.description: Why it failed. Absent when it succeeded.

field.description: The request field the message concerns, when the refusal is about one.

DiagnosedRefusal.description: A typed Diagnostic, or the plain Refusal a refusal falls back to until its producer is typed. Only `kind` tells them apart.

Resource.description: A kind of record a reference, a declaration or an action names (ADR-0052).

Candidate.description: One record an ambiguous reference could have meant.

Consequence.description: What a destructive step does to work, typed so a Client never reads it from the consequence sentence.

ExplicitChoice.description: A destructive step is taken only by an explicit choice, whatever its consequence says; a Client never runs it as a default or automatic repair.

Diagnostic.description: Why kestrel would not do what it was asked, and the ordered, typed next steps that repair, inspect or retry it (ADR-0052). `message` is display only; a Client never classifies it.

organization.description: Null when the resource is not scoped to an Organization.

constraint.description: The existing author/name constraint the action violates, when established.

holding_session.description: The Session holding the conflicting state, when the conflict is one.

saved.description: What a write saved before the service it then asked could not answer.

provider_error.description: The provider's error type or code, never its message.

CredentialRejectedDiagnostic.description: A provider refused the credential itself when it was saved, so whatever was saved before is kept.

sign_in.description: The catalogued Sign-in Method the failure is about, when one is established.

attribution.description: established: the method selected, or the only catalogued sign-in the harness was handed. uncertain: it was handed several and nothing says which it refused, so none is blamed. unattributed: it was handed none kestrel catalogues.

candidates.description: The methods an uncertain failure could be about; empty otherwise.

holding.description: Where the established sign-in is held.

revision.description: The revision of the established sign-in the harness was handed.

current.description: Whether that revision is still what is held. Only a current revision is marked as needing attention; a replaced one keeps this diagnosis.

expired.description: Established only from evidence; never inferred from arbitrary harness output.

AuthenticationRequiredEvidence.description: The agent answered with ACP's authentication-required error.

methods.description: The ids of the ACP auth methods the agent offered.

method.description: The ACP auth method the supervisor was configured to log in with.

UnknownEvidence.description: What the agent said, bounded and redacted. It never establishes that a sign-in expired or is not covered.

Action.description: A typed corrective, inspective or retry step a Diagnostic offers, naming its own inputs rather than a shell command or browser route (ADR-0052). A Client binds it to a form, a flag or an API call.

missing.description: Which of this action's fixed inputs are not yet known, from `name`.
Which of this action's fixed inputs are not yet known, from `name`, `repositories`, `branch`.
Which of this action's fixed inputs are not yet known, from `name`, `harness`.
Which of this action's fixed inputs are not yet known, from `name`, `owner`.

name.description: The credential's variable. Its value is always collected privately and never serialized here.

consequence.description: Display-only explanation of the destructive effect; wording never decides whether confirmation is required.

ConnectGithubAction.description: Connect a repository through a GitHub App, which is what lends a Session the authority to push.

organization.description: Null when no Organization exists yet.

ReplaceIntegrationPrivateKeyAction.description: Never carries the key: a Client reads it from a file or standard input when the step is taken.

consequence.description: Display-only explanation of the destructive effect; wording never decides whether confirmation is required.

sign_in.description: A safe locator for which sign-in to use, never held material.

compose.description: Whether Compose-specific checks apply, known only from the selected deployment's own evidence.

RetryRequestAction.description: The write was refused before anything was saved, so sending the same request again is safe.

uncertain.description: Whether the operation's result is unknown, used after a lost write response. Never a signal to replay the write.

RunningUnit.description: Work an adapter declared it runs apart from any tool call, such as a Claude background task, open until the adapter settles it. A settled unit adds no Transcript entry.

sessions.description: The blocking Sessions that have not ended successfully.

session.description: The Session holding the Profile; null when a non-Session use holds it.

instance.description: The idle Instance being archived, or that dispatch will archive, to make room.

limit.description: The Organization's live Instance limit, reached with no idle Instance known recoverable.
The Active-Work Slot limit, every slot occupied.

sessions.description: Earlier eligible slot requests in this Organization, in global dispatch order.

elsewhere.description: Earlier eligible slot requests in other Organizations, omitted when zero.
